camel_example: aliyun csas UpdateVirusFileStatus --region cn-hangzhou --FilePath 'C:_Users_Public_Downloads_setup.exe' --FileMd5 d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e --DevTag '36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000' --Operation AdminQuarantine
description_en: Quarantines or trusts a virus file on a specified user terminal device. DevTag, FilePath, and FileMd5 together identify a virus file record. The call fails if the record does not exist. Quarantine is an asynchronous operation. After the server creates a disposal task, the user terminal device pulls and executes it. The same virus file record can only be disposed of once within one minute
description_zh: 对指定用户终端设备上的病毒文件执行隔离或信任处置。DevTag、FilePath与FileMd5三者共同定位一条病毒文件记录，记录不存在时调用失败。隔离为异步操作，服务端创建处置任务后由用户终端设备拉取执行。同一条病毒文件记录1分钟内只允许处置一次
kebab_example: aliyun csas update-virus-file-status --dev-tag 36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000 --file-path C:_Users_Public_Downloads_setup.exe --file-md5 d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e --operation AdminQuarantine --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirusFileStatus

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the user terminal device where the virus file is located. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~): lists virus file statuses
parameters.help_zh:
病毒文件所在用户终端设备的唯一标识。长度不超过64个字符。取值来源：
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~)：批量查询病毒文件状态
parameters.name: dev_tag

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the virus file on the user terminal device. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~): lists virus file statuses
parameters.help_zh:
病毒文件在用户终端设备上的绝对路径。取值来源：
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~)：批量查询病毒文件状态
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en:
The MD5 value of the virus file. The value must be a 32-character hexadecimal string. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~): lists virus file statuses
parameters.help_zh:
病毒文件的MD5值，必须为32位十六进制字符。取值来源：
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~)：批量查询病毒文件状态
parameters.name: file_md5

parameters.help_en:
The disposal action. Valid values:
AdminQuarantine: quarantines the virus file. The server creates a disposal task and returns a TaskId. The user terminal device pulls and executes the quarantine.
AdminTrust: trusts the virus file. Only the disposal status is updated. No disposal task is created, and TaskId returns an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作。取值：
AdminQuarantine：隔离该病毒文件。服务端创建处置任务并返回TaskId，由用户终端设备拉取后执行隔离。
AdminTrust：信任该病毒文件。仅更新处置状态，不创建处置任务，TaskId返回空字符串
parameters.name: operation

Backdoor: backdoor program.
DDoS: DDoS Trojan.
Downloader: downloader Trojan.
Engtest: DPI engine test program.
Hacktool: hacker tool.
Trojan: self-mutating Trojan.
Malbaseware: contaminated base software.
MalScript: malicious script.
Malware: malicious program.
Miner: mining programs.
Proxytool: proxy tool.
RansomWare: ransomware.
RiskWare: riskware.
Rootkit: kernel-hidden program.
Stealer: credential stealer.
Scanner: scanner.
Suspicious: suspicious program.
Virus: file-infecting virus.
WebShell: webshell.
Worm: worms.
BlackList: file that hit a blacklist entry.
Exp: vulnerability exploits program.
Patcher: cracking program.
Gametool: private server tool.
AdWare: adware.
Maldoc: malicious document

TaskId.description_en: The disposal task ID. This parameter is returned when Operation is set to AdminQuarantine. An empty string is returned when Operation is set to AdminTrust. You can check the execution result on the user terminal device by using the TaskExecutionInfo field of ListVirusFileStatuses
TaskId.description_zh: 处置任务ID。Operation取值为AdminQuarantine时返回，取值为AdminTrust时返回空字符串。可通过ListVirusFileStatuses的TaskExecutionInfo查看用户终端设备的执行结果
